twitter profile cleaner upper 

background: on someone's profile, often I just want to see their tweets. no retweets and no "37/142: " thread tweets. just give me their tweets and only the ones that are first if in a thread

idea: create a simple chrome extension to do this

author: alexalbert__
text:
going to submit it to chrome store and will publish link when done

ended up using hacky jquery calls to hide tweet divs, probably a better way to do this but I got tired searching through chrome dev tools

author: alexalbert__
text:
not sure if AR will ever truly succeed until it gets down to level of being in your contacts or we reach retinal implant status (hallucinating images into your eyesight), whichever comes first

still bullish on it for media/work purposes but not as much for just everyday carry

author: alexalbert__
text:
long been a proponent of AR with seamless contextual info replacing the need to interrupt your flow by pulling out your phone all the time

however, something I never considered until I watched @imranchaudhri latest talk was the inherent problem of covering your eyes 24/7
